name: "Goodnight."
source:
A short kinetic novel about a nameless boy who expresses his thoughts under the gentle shine of the night sky.

[From [url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/goodnight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇无选项视觉小说，讲述一名无名少年在夜空温柔的光辉下，诉说自己心中所想。

[译自[url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/goodnight]Itch.io[/url]]
